decisionRationale: role values in the generic structural matcher are intentionally unrestricted
AND([F,Y])->F / AND([T,Y])->Y therefore defines a broader guard/pass-through law for arbitrary Link Y
canonical AND is kept as strict Boolean logic over the local T/F domain instead of overloading AND with that broader law
the broader two-rule law may be modeled later as a distinct operator if required

semanticModel.domain: ExactSequence([F|T,F|T]); any operand outside the local T/F domain is NO_MATCH
semanticModel.executionOperation: same generalized Γ; zero-role Rules are the grounded refinement of the shared Rule topology

compatibilityBoundary.note: backend representation may differ for performance but must preserve the one canonical AND semantics and still execute through generic Γ

falsifiers: non-Boolean operand yields NO_MATCH instead of pass-through
frozen out-of-domain launch yields zero matches and quiescence
approvalBoundary: exact reviewed candidate is Author-approved and promoted as compact-boolean-and
immutable approved artifacts live under formal/v0.15/regression/compact-and.*
future simpler AND candidates do not mutate this approved regression witness
any material replacement of canonical AND requires a new explicit Author decision
